gated_construction.construction_type: two independent ReGLU multiplication gates plus linear skip
gated_construction.limitations: Two bilinear ReGLU gates, not equivalent cost to 255 ordinary ReLU gates; not a general neural net optimizer, universal transformer VM, WASM i32 wraparound gate or proof of numerical exactness at unsafe magnitudes.
gated_construction.numeric_contract: exact integer float64 on explicitly budgeted inputs

limitations: Analytic two-ReGLU-gate construction of one known quadratic, with fixed input signs and a separate linear skip. Exact-real algebraic identity solver-checked by sign cases; exact float64 integers only under an explicit bound. Unlike original ReLU network, not a full i32 modular neural implementation. Not a trained architecture discovery, GPU performance claim, or universal neural interpreter.
